name: Cost report
desc: What each box, container and model cost in power this week, and what changed. Report only.
prompt: Report this week's power cost: get_costs (range 7d) for the fleet and per host, and get_entity_cost for the three most expensive containers, services or models. Compare with what you can see of the previous period and name what changed most. Keep it to a few lines with numbers and the currency the tool reports.
